segments.an5.76:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco yodhājīvo asicammaṃ gahetvā dhanukalāpaṃ sannayhitvā viyūḷhaṃ saṅgāmaṃ otarati.
segments.an5.76:1.5: Tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti.
segments.an5.76:1.7: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
segments.an5.76:2.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idhekacco yodhājīvo asicammaṃ gahetvā dhanukalāpaṃ sannayhitvā viyūḷhaṃ saṅgāmaṃ otarati.
segments.an5.76:2.3: Tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare upalikkhanti [upalikhanti (ka.)], tamenaṃ apanenti;
segments.an5.76:2.5: So ñātakehi nīyamāno appatvāva ñātake antarāmagge kālaṃ karoti.
segments.an5.76:2.7: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.

segments.an5.76:3.3: Tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare upalikkhanti, tamenaṃ apanenti;
segments.an5.76:3.6: So ñātakehi upaṭṭhahiyamāno paricariyamāno teneva ābādhena kālaṃ karoti.

segments.an5.76:5.2: So taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo tameva saṅgāmasīsaṃ ajjhāvasati.

segments.an5.76:6.1: “Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcime yodhājīvūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā bhikkhūsu.
segments.an5.76:6.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu aññataraṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharati.
segments.an5.76:6.4: So pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya tameva gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati arakkhiteneva kāyena arakkhitāya vācāya arakkhitena cittena anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā asaṃvutehi indriyehi.
segments.an5.76:6.5: So tattha passati mātugāmaṃ dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā.
segments.an5.76:6.6: Tassa taṃ mātugāmaṃ disvā dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti.
segments.an5.76:6.7: So rāgānuddhaṃsitena cittena sikkhaṃ apaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevati.

Evarūpopi, bhikkhave, idhekacco puggalo hoti.
segments.an5.76:7.2: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.

lines: Apanetvā ñātakānaṃ nentīti sakasenaṃ netvā tato ñātakānaṃ santikaṃ nenti.
Nīyamānoti attano gehaṃ vā sesañātisantikaṃ vā niyyamāno.
Rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃsetīti rāgo uppajjamānova samathavipassanācittaṃ dhaṃseti, dūre khipati.
Rāgapariyuṭṭhitomhi, āvuso, rāgaparetoti ahaṃ, āvuso, rāgena ratto, rāgena anugato.
Chaṭṭhe cammanti iminā cammamayaṃ cammamiti sibbitaṃ, aññaṃ vā keṭakaphalakādiṃ saṅgaṇhāti.
Yuddhasannivesena ṭhitanti dvinnaṃ senānaṃ byūhanasaṃvidhānanayena kato yo sanniveso, tassa vasena ṭhitaṃ, senābyūhasaṃvidhānavasena sanniviṭṭhanti vuttaṃ hoti.
Ussāhañca vāyāmañca karotīti yujjhanavasena ussāhaṃ vāyāmañca karoti.
Tenāha “pariyāpādayantī”ti, jīvitaṃ pariyāpādayanti maraṇaṃ paṭipajjāpentīti vuttaṃ hoti.
Arakkhiteneva kāyenātiādīsu hatthapāde kīḷāpento gīvaṃ viparivattento kāyaṃ na rakkhati nāma.
Nānappakāraṃ duṭṭhullaṃ karonto vācaṃ na rakkhati nāma.
Kāmavitakkādayo vitakkento cittaṃ na rakkhati nāma.
Rāgaparetoti vā rāgena phuṭṭho phuṭṭhavisena viya sappena.
